report_revision.completion_scope: Collection relabeling,500-step training and four planned strength panels complete; no retrospective execution completion timestamp assigned.
report_revision.interpretation: Relative avg4-vs-single fitting and matchup advantages supported; net gain vs initial and long-run self-iteration unconfirmed. Follow-up proceeds using averaging signal without fresh-M1.
report_revision.producer_scope: Current post-run script inspected at review; the pre-execution producer version was not frozen. This snapshot does not fill that historical provenance gap.
report_revision.verification_scope: Input/labels/ledger hashes, exact control model and AdamW state reproduction, CPU fit cross-check, four raw strength panels (500 natural terminal games) and bootstrap recomputation inspected during review; no new search/training/evaluation.

scope: Replays the frozen 200-game native collection at the 16500 checkpoint. The averaged arm replaces only policy visit-distribution targets; value labels, value batches and optimizer settings are identical to the existing native arm. Single start/collection seed; pilot strength panels.
